name: filter-bar
title: Filter Bar
description: The two-row toolbar above a list or table — search (~320px) left; a Filters (n) toggle, scope Tabs and the view switch right; compact rounded-md filter chips (FilterBarFacet, DateRangeFilter with presets) on a toggled row 12px below that scrolls sideways on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Filter toolbars for lists/tables — 'Label: value' chips that edit in place, facets on SearchableSelect, an Add-filter menu and a settled search, at the end or first.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single search box (Input), value selection (Select), or unrelated row actions.
